name: Ard-Greimne

attributes.attribute: father of the warrior women Scathach and Aífe

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ard-Greimne is an Irish mythological figure. He is otherwise obscure in the tales. He is the father of the great warrior women of the Isle of Skye, Scathach and her sister or rival Aífe.

key_results: Show him as the father of Scathach and Aífe.
